name: converge-reflections-destroy-distortion-draw
notes: Engine gap, FIXED: Converge Reflections' printed text is "As an additional cost to activate this card, sacrifice a non-token item or weapon you control. Destroy target item or weapon with memory cost 0 or reserve cost 4 or less. If that object was a Distortion, draw a card into your memory." activateCardPrereqs["TBVLLRPiwP:0"] (GeneratedCode/GeneratedMacroCode.php ~line 565) already correctly gated activation on having a sacrificeable non-token item/weapon, and cardActivatedAbilities["TBVLLRPiwP:0"]/customDQHandlers["TBVLLRPiwP:0:CardActivated-1"] (~lines 21716/36826) already correctly destroyed the target and drew into memory when it was a Distortion -- but no generated code anywhere ever performed the sacrifice itself, confirmed live: the seeded sac-fodder item remained on the field, untouched, at the end of the action sequence. Unlike the other recent fixes on this branch, the gap was not a wrong/missing variable inside an existing generated dispatch-table entry to override via GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php -- there was no generated code path at all for the additional-cost sacrifice to hook into, so that override convention does not apply here (nothing to override). Investigation of DoActivateCard() (Custom/GameLogic.php, 1.3 Declaring Costs section, ~line 2812 before this fix) showed this is exactly where every other card with a mandatory-sacrifice additional cost (Broken Promises/BrokenPromisesCost, Primordial Ritual, Undeniable Truth, Blazing Throw, etc.) is hand-wired by CardID, entirely in hand-written tracked GameLogic.php, before the card's reserve cost is paid and before EffectStackOpportunity queues the ability for resolution (i.e. before cardActivatedAbilities ever runs). Fixed by adding a new cost block for CardID 'TBVLLRPiwP' in that same DoActivateCard() section (mirroring Blazing Throw's WEAPON-sacrifice shape, extended to also allow ITEM/REGALIA since the printed cost is 'a non-token item or weapon'), using the same ZoneSearch(myField, [ITEM,REGALIA]) + ZoneSearch(myField, [WEAPON]) non-token filter as the existing (already-correct) activateCardPrereqs legality gate, so the cost payment can never find fewer eligible targets than the prereq already verified exist. The new $hasConvergeReflectionsCost flag was added to the big combined additional-cost gate on the 'no special cost' branch and to the handler-ownership comment block, and a new customDQHandlers['ConvergeReflectionsCost'] handler (paired with the MZCHOOSE decision, following BrokenPromisesCost/BlazingThrowCost's shape) actually sacrifices the chosen object via DoSacrificeFighter() -- the same generic sacrifice helper BlazingThrowCost already uses for a WEAPON, confirmed via DoAllyDestroyed() to work for any object type -- before queuing the normal reserve-cost payments and EffectStackOpportunity. Even with only one legal sacrifice target on the field, the engine still issues a real MZCHOOSE decision (matching the Broken Promises pattern) that the fixture's action sequence now answers explicitly (myField-1, immediately after the FSM activation and before the reserve-cost payments), rather than an automatic/implicit pick. Added two new assertions: myField zone_count == 1 (only the champion remains) and the sacrificed Y34Imzlr0n (Shardforged Blade, type REGALIA,WEAPON) present in myBanish, not myGraveyard -- live debugging (temporary stderr instrumentation in DoAllyDestroyed/MZMove, removed before commit) confirmed GraveyardAddReplacement() (Custom/GameLogic.php ~line 17978) unconditionally redirects any REGALIA-type object from graveyard to banish, which is also why the pre-existing destroyed-Distortion assertion below already expected theirBanish rather than theirGraveyard for idpdon8f0h -- this is correct, pre-existing engine behavior, not something introduced by this fix. All five assertions moved from step 5 to step 6 since inserting the new sacrifice-choice action (now action index 1, 0-indexed) shifted the fixture from 5 to 6 total actions, and RunIntegrationTests.php's step numbering is stepIndex+1 (1-indexed) against the action list, so the final action (now index 5) is step 6, not step 5. Break/restore verified (via `git stash` of only GrandArchiveSim/Custom/GameLogic.php, leaving the updated fixture files in place): temporarily removing the new 'TBVLLRPiwP' cost block from DoActivateCard() (restoring the prior gap, so no MZCHOOSE for the sacrifice is ever queued after the FSM activation) makes the fixture fail at 'Step 2 failed: Invalid selection.' -- the fixture's myField-1 action has no matching pending decision to answer (activation proceeds straight into reserve payment instead), so the engine rejects it outright -- a clean, specific failure tied directly to the restored gap. Restoring the fix (git stash pop) passes all five assertions again. Full suite: 742/742 after the fix.

rulesClauses: As an additional cost to activate this card, sacrifice a non-token item or weapon you control. Destroy target item or weapon with memory cost 0 or reserve cost 4 or less. If that object was a Distortion, draw a card into your memory.
